why: Part of the Lake Tschida - Southside, Hawabesi & Gilligan's Hilltop entry (lake-tschida-hawabesi-southside.json): its four full-hookup sites are ~150 m from Hawabesi and ~450 m from Southside off the same access and Schatz Station (laketschida.org map, read 2026-11-12), not a separate campground.
